subject: Function for tooltip content works for 1 out of 47 observations

messages.author: 3a42213e2dc51134
messages.subject: Function for tooltip content works for 1 out of 47 observations
parts:
Hello,

I have a dataset of corporate twitter accounts and have plotted them using ggvis. I've attached the relevant portion of my dataset if you'd like to reproduce it.
I want to add a tooltip that displays the name of the company attached to each record.
The function below takes the number of followers and correctly returns the company name:

d<-read.csv(data.csv)

f<-function(y){
           m<-as.matrix(d$company,47,1)
           company<-m[which(d$followers==y)]
           company
        }

You can test this by entering f(106000) or f(14700), or any other values from d$followers.

However when I put this function in the add_tooltip function:

p<- d %>% ggvis(~rx,~followers) %>% layer_points()
p %>% add_tooltip(f,"hover")

the plot displays blank tooltips for all datapoints with the exception of the second row in my dataset, Pfizer. Please let me know if you have any ideas as to what I'm doing wrong. Thanks for your interest/help!

Andrew
